## MCP - Text Embedder

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/text-embedder

**Parameters:**
- `text` (required): String or array of strings to embed
- `openai_api_key` (required): OpenAI API key
- `model` (optional): Embedding model (default: text-embedding-3-small)
- `dimensions` (optional): Output dimensions (default: 1536)

**Models:**
- `text-embedding-3-small`: Fast, cost-effective (default)
- `text-embedding-3-large`: Higher quality, more dimensions
- `text-embedding-ada-002`: Legacy model

**Returns:** Array of embeddings with dimensions
